usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of Iraq official rate (homepage converter; daily US dollar rate files on the exchange-rates page)
usdRate.note: 1,510 dinars per US dollar shown by the Central Bank of Iraq's currency converter (undated; read on 31 October and again on 3 November 2026); the exchange-rates page links to the daily rate files. Trading Economics shows the market rate at 1,515.3 on 3 November 2026, the dinar having weakened about 15.7% over the past month; the World Bank 2025 average was 1,300.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Central Statistical Organization Iraq, inflation September 2026, via Trading Economics
inflation_cpi.note: 3.8% in September 2026 (3.3% in August); core 3.9%. Secondary source; the statistics office site was not read. World Bank 2025 average 0.3%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Central Statistical Organization inflation 3.8% (September 2026); World Bank 2025 0.3%
inflation_projection.note: The Central Bank of Iraq publishes no numeric target; inflation has mostly run between 0% and 5% recently, and the dinar's move from about 1,300 to 1,510 per dollar adds import-price pressure, so a rounded 3.5% is used.

policy_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Iraq policy rate, via Trading Economics
policy_rate.note: 5.50% at the October 2026 reading, unchanged from the previous one; secondary source because the central bank homepage shows no policy rate.

savings_account_rate.note: No current industry-wide savings account rate could be read from the Central Bank of Iraq; its interest-rate page (https://cbi.iq/page/143) lists bank rate tables only up to 2024, in spreadsheet files.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No current industry-wide 3-month fixed deposit rate could be read from the Central Bank of Iraq; its interest-rate page (https://cbi.iq/page/143) lists bank rate tables only up to 2024, in spreadsheet files.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No current industry-wide 1-year fixed deposit rate could be read from the Central Bank of Iraq; its interest-rate page (https://cbi.iq/page/143) lists bank rate tables only up to 2024, in spreadsheet files.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product or rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: No recent average deposit rate was found; the World Bank series (FR.INR.DPST) stops at 4.78% in 2016, too old to use.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No continuously sold government savings certificate for individuals was confirmed; the Ministry of Finance has sold occasional public bond issues.

tbill_91d_rate.note: Treasury bills are auctioned to banks; no current 91-day yield could be read from the Central Bank of Iraq; its interest-rate page (https://cbi.iq/page/143) lists bank rate tables only up to 2024, in spreadsheet files.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No current 5-year government bond yield could be read.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year government bond yield was found.

tax_bank_interest.note: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries (Iraq, last reviewed 24 June 2026) gives no specific rate or exemption for resident individuals' bank interest; the Central Bank of Iraq interest-rate page publishes only bank rate tables.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was confirmed, and the tax on government bond income could not be read.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: A deposit insurance arrangement under the Central Bank of Iraq is reported, but its cover per depositor could not be read from an official source.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit card rate was found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Iraq policy rate 5.5%; small, illiquid Iraq Stock Exchange
equity_return_low.note: Low case: the thinly traded local market returns little in dinars.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank of Iraq policy rate 5.5%; assumed after-tax deposit rate about 4%
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 2 points over the after-tax safe rate, below the 4-point cap, because the Iraq Stock Exchange is small with no strong 10-year record.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Iraq policy rate 5.5%; inflation assumption 3.5%
equity_return_high.note: High case: equities beat inflation by about 6 points a year.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Iraq official rate 1,510 dinars per US dollar (October 2026) against 1,300 in 2025 (World Bank)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with a stable dinar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank of Iraq exchange rate; long-run dollar gold trend about 4%
gold_return_base.note: Base case: about 4% dollar gold trend plus about 2% a year of dinar depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Iraq exchange rate history (1,300 to 1,510 per dollar)
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold and further devaluations like the 2026 one.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Iraq policy rate 5.5%
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: ordinary savings rates well below the policy rate.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank of Iraq policy rate 5.5%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits a little below the policy rate, after any tax; bank rates were not published.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Iraq policy rate 5.5%
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer deposits and government bonds at about the policy rate.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio could be read from the Insurance Diwan.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Life insurance penetration is very low and no published term-life premium rates per 1,000 dinars of cover by age were found from the regulator or another public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found from the regulator or another public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Iraq
oop_health_share.note: 54.0% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank); older than 2025, the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.note: Private clinics and imported medicines drive health costs, so health goals are planned 2.5 points above the general assumption.

goal_inflation_education.note: Public education is free but private school and university fees rise faster than general prices, so 1.5 points above the general assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Iraq
life_expectancy.note: 72.4 years in 2024 (men 70.5, women 74.2), the latest World Bank year, older than 2025; UN WPP 2024 gives 72.6 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 5.70 (2025, World Bank), 8.9 (2040) and 16.2 (2065, populationpyramid.net/iraq/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: The pension age for private-sector workers under the Social Security and Retirement Law for Workers (Law No. 18 of 2023) could not be read from an official source.

retirement_age_government.note: The civil-service retirement age under the Unified Retirement Law (No. 9 of 2014, as amended) is reported as 60 but could not be read from an official source.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Iraq policy rate 5.5%
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings rates after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank of Iraq policy rate 5.5%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: below the assumed 4% after-tax term deposit rate, so not above the safe rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Iraq policy rate 5.5%
retirement_return_high.note: High case: long deposits and government bonds near the policy rate.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a mix earning about deposit rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Fixed income base 4%; equity base 6%; gold base 6%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits, gold and some equity in a shallow market.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: a growth-leaning mix with gold.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: The Social Protection Network of the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs pays means-tested cash support to poor households including older people, but the current monthly amount for an elderly person could not be read.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Eligibility rules for social protection support to older people could not be read from an official source.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory end-of-service gratuity for private employees could be confirmed from the Labour Law (No. 37 of 2015).

public_pension_scheme.note: Private-sector workers are covered by the social security fund under the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs (employee 5%, employer 12% of net salaries per PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Iraq, reviewed 24 June 2026), but its pension age and indexation rules could not be read from an official source.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was confirmed.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No continuously sold government savings certificate for individuals was confirmed.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned mainly to banks; access for individuals is limited.

tbond_5y.note: Mainly held by banks; occasional public issues have been sold to individuals.

equity_fund.note: No diversified equity or index fund sold to retail investors was found; the Iraq Stock Exchange is supervised by the Iraq Securities Commission.

gold.note: Gold is bought mostly as jewellery; investment bars and coins are also sold.

insuranceRegulator.name: Insurance Diwan (Insurance Regulatory Authority), Ministry of Finance

pensionScheme.name: Social security for workers, Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs

oldAgeAllowance.name: Social Protection Network, Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health (public hospitals and clinics)
